reviewer.evidence: Independently read every message in all 12 slices against English defaults for Odia meaning, neutral UI register, Odia script, and label context; confirmed LTR registration and reviewed each exact English-identical value. Corrected citation terminology and several plural forms for words, chunks, XML child nodes and GeoJSON features. Source parsing confirms 1,315 ordered keys, no missing or extra messages, matching placeholders, and CLDR one/other plural forms. AI-assisted; no native-speaker certification is claimed. Updated 2026-09-28: an independent AI-assisted review checked all 69 added messages for meaning, UI register, terminology and placeholders, and corrected the catalog before this snapshot. The research-source count was checked against the pinned CLDR categories, including locale-specific decimal and non-singular forms. The complete 1,384-key snapshot was checked for key coverage, value kinds, placeholders and exact-English message paths; only individually justified new cognates, loanwords and technical names were retained. This increment does not claim a new linguistic review of all older messages, human review or native-speaker certification.
